source.basis: Industry value-chain template + curated product/market rivals for HK MVP hubs (trial batch). Not a live supplier API dump. Prefer .HK dual-list counters on HK pages. Preview-before-merge.
source.notes_zh: 本頁為港股 MVP 龍頭供應鏈／競爭策展種子（產業價值鏈模板＋人工策展對手）。未呼叫即時供應商 API；FMP 同業名單不作價值鏈依據。雙重上市優先港股 .HK 代號。競爭對手採產品／市場真實對手原則（參考美股 AAPL 教訓：不以階段玩家或跨業巨頭灌水）。
source.notes_en: HK MVP hub curated seed (industry value-chain template + curated rivals). No live supplier API. FMP peers are not the value chain. Dual-listed names prefer .HK on HK pages. Competitors follow true product/market rivalry (AAPL lesson).
source.competitorRationale_zh: 競爭弧只列與該公司主力產品／市場重疊的對手；供應鏈階段玩家與競爭對手分開；雙重上市優先 .HK。
source.competitorRationale_en: Rival arc lists product/market overlaps only; stage players stay separate from rivals; dual listings prefer .HK.
